title: Basic English — Course 2, Semester 2 — Pilot Variant 13

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Where will the joint session take place?
tasks.audioText: The mathematics and science departments are holding a joint session on presenting research data. It will begin at eleven on Monday in the computer laboratory. Students will practise choosing suitable chart types and describing trends without exaggerating results. They should bring a small table of figures from a recent class project.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which classroom materials are needed for the session?
tasks.audioText: The mathematics and science departments are holding a joint session on presenting research data. It will begin at eleven on Monday in the computer laboratory. Students will practise choosing suitable chart types and describing trends without exaggerating results. They should bring a small table of figures from a recent class project.
options: A small table of figures from a recent class project

tasks.prompt: A student compared the monthly energy use of two college buildings. Building A used less electricity in most months, but the difference became smaller during the winter. The student included the number of rooms in each building because their sizes were not the same. She avoided saying that one building was more efficient until she could compare energy use per square metre. Reading 1. Why did the student include the number of rooms?
options: Because the buildings were different sizes

tasks.prompt: Why did she avoid making an immediate conclusion about efficiency?
options: She needed to compare energy use per square metre

tasks.prompt: The figures should be compared ___ the size of each building.
Choose TWO practices that improve the presentation of research data.
options: Remove figures that do not support your opinion

tasks.prompt: A visual display of numerical information is a ___.
A chart shows a small increase, but the difference may not be significant. What should you write?
options: The results prove a major change.
The data show a small increase; further analysis may be needed.
The chart is useless and should be deleted.
The increase is definitely caused by one factor.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of interpreting research data in a logical order.
options: Describe the pattern and relevant context
Check the units and source of the data
Choose a suitable way to display the figures
correctOrder: Check the units and source of the data
Choose a suitable way to display the figures
Describe the pattern and relevant context

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how to present research data clearly and avoid misleading conclusions.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); appropriate vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
